rationale: Both solutions are clean, correct and very similar. B has slightly better structure. A separate verse(n) function keeps Recite as a simple loop that joins verses with blank lines. For a dense 0..10 lookup, a slice is more idiomatic Go than a map with int keys. The fmt.Sprintf templates also make each lyric line easy to read. A's bottlePhrase helper is a nice touch that avoids repeating the 'green' text, and its doc comments are a bit more thorough. However, A puts verse construction and separator logic in the same loop. Neither solution validates out-of-range counts: B would panic and A would quietly produce an empty word. On balance B reads a little more clearly.
